subject: Discovery follow-up — tri-shift mosaic scheduling for technical deep dive
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@medtech.ai>, Tom Lee <tom@novacorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up — tri-shift mosaic scheduling for technical deep dive

Hi Samira / Tom,

Really appreciate you both taking time today — quick recap and an ask to lock the technical deep dive.

Recap (from today’s call):
- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood inference runtime for productionizing low-latency clinical note summarization (PII redaction, 1–2s token latency target at 512 tokens).
- Key constraints: on-prem data residency for PHI, SOC2 evidence needed, and predictable throughput (150–300 qps spike).
- Stakeholders to include in next call: ML engineering (Samira), Platform/SRE (Tom), and our architecture lead.

Next step: schedule the technical deep dive (deep-dive + infra checklist + short exec summary). Because you have teammates in US/EU/APAC, we put together a rotating pattern we call the "tri-shift mosaic" — a lightweight recurring rotation so the meeting falls in appropriate local business hours for different stakeholders each week. The idea: one weekly deep-dive, rotating among three anchor windows so each region gets a friendly slot over a three-week cycle.

Proposed anchor windows (examples — local equivalents shown):
- Window A (US-friendly): 09:30–11:00 PT (US West) / 12:30–14:00 ET (US East)
- Window B (EU-friendly): 15:00–16:30 BST / 16:00–17:30 CEST
- Window C (APAC-friendly): 08:00–09:30 SGT / 10:00–11:30 AEST

Operational details:
- Rotation cadence: weekly — A then B then C, repeat.
- One-hour technical agenda + 30m optional ops deep-dive (SRE/infra).
- We'll attach the draft agenda and a light pre-call checklist (attached).

Can you confirm: which anchor window is best for your core team for the next session? If helpful, I can propose three candidate dates in each window next week and share a calendar poll.

Attachments: medtech_discovery-notes.pdf, demo-outline-v2.pptx (agenda + suggested infra checklist).

Thanks —
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai

Tessa — thanks for the recap and for proposing the rotation concept. Quick notes from our side:

- We like the rotation idea; fair way to include stakeholders across time zones without making anyone meet at odd hours every week.
- Preference for the next call: EU-friendly window (Window B) if we have to pick one. Our core ML team (London / Berlin) can't do very early APAC slots, and Tom (NY) prefers not to do late-evening ET often.
- Candidate constraints: Mondays and Thursdays work best for us next week (Mon 23 or Thu 26 is ideal).
- Please include our platform architect (Ravi Shah; r.shah@medtech.ai) and one SRE (cc’ing him would be great).

If you can send a quick 3-slot poll for Window B (EU-friendly) next week that would help us lock — otherwise list three specific datetimes and we’ll pick.

Best,
Samira
Samira Khan

2) Thu 2025-06-26 16:00–17:30 CEST (Thu 26 / Window B)
